sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a quiet surge of panicked embarrassment and self-reproach, worried that starting the term late has already gone wrong.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: I only meant to look at the time...
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered and embarrassed, quietly trying to excuse herself while inwardly panicking about being late on the very first day.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is startled and flustered, with a brief burst of panic at the unexpected hit to her face, but her embarrassment is already being swallowed by her usual quiet restraint.
sprite_sequence.label: surprised

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered and embarrassed by the string of mishaps, but is trying to stay composed and push through without panicking.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is panicked and breathless, urgently trying to stop the bus from leaving while still clinging to a quiet, embarrassed determination not to give up.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a quiet, sinking mix of embarrassment and resignation, trying to accept the bad luck without showing how flustered and disappointed she really is.
sprite_sequence.label: sad

sprite_sequence.text: Good morning. I'm sorry for... this shape.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is mortified and flustered, but trying to stay polite and composed by turning her embarrassment into a quiet, awkward joke.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: I haven't ridden one in a while.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed and uncertain, but is quietly trying to stay composed and accept the help without making a fuss.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: Maybe... maybe I can still make homeroom.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels cautious, breathless hope mixed with lingering embarrassment, trying to steady herself and cling to the possibility that she can still recover the morning.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: Why is there a daikon in the basket...
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is quietly stunned and exhausted, with a thin thread of disbelief and resigned embarrassment after yet another absurd setback.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: ...This was supposed to be a good start.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels quietly defeated and embarrassed, with a small, resigned sadness at how badly her first day has gone despite trying so hard to start well.
sprite_sequence.label: sad

sprite_sequence.text: I ironed everything. I checked everything. I really tried.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels quietly crushed and frustrated, with a fragile hurt beneath her self-reproach because she genuinely tried to prepare and still ended up failing.
sprite_sequence.label: sad

sprite_sequence.text: I'm fine. Just... losing to vegetables.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is embarrassed and quietly defeated, trying to mask her frustration with dry humor while holding back tears and keeping her composure.
sprite_sequence.label: holding_back_tears

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed and overwhelmed, but also quietly relieved and grateful that someone is helping her after a humiliating morning.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: Right. Running sounds simpler than cycling.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed but relieved, quietly accepting help and trying to regain composure with a small, wry sense of humor.
sprite_sequence.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels exhausted and faintly relieved, with a shy, self-deprecating sense of triumph after barely surviving the morning.
sprite_sequence.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

sprite_sequence.text: Please don't tell anyone about the daikon.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels shyly embarrassed and vulnerable, but also relieved enough to make a small, self-protective joke as she asks for discretion.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused
